crossRefs.note: therefore you will serve your enemies whom Yahweh sends against you, in hunger, in thirst, in nakedness, and in lack of…
For, behold, the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, takes away from Jerusalem and from Judah supply and support, the whole supply…
“Take for yourself also wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet, and spelt, and put them in one vessel. Make bread of it.…

translations.web: We have drunken our water for money. Our wood is sold to us.
translations.bsb: We must buy the water we drink; our wood comes at a price.
translations.kjv: We have drunken our water for money; our wood is sold
translations.asv: We have drunken our water for money; Our wood is sold unto us.
